1.
Heard Shri Sanjay Srivastava, learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State respondents and perused the records.

2. This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 20.06.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 0369 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 406 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Handia, District Prayagraj.

sentences.text: Vide order dated 01.06.2023 matter was referred to mediation centre.

Learned counsel for the petitioner states that although requisite amount was deposited before the mediation centre,
however, only respondent no.4 alongwith her counsel was present before the mediation centre on 20.08.2023.
Learned counsel for the petitioner states that as the petitioners did not receive notice he could not appear.

4. At this stage, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents submits that that the charge-sheet No. 194 of 2023 has already been forwarded on 14.03.2023 in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
5. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
